comparators.name: Nuisance-only held-mouse ridge
comparators.inputs: Distance and squared distance, independent baseline, measured movement, power and independently pretest site class
comparators.procedure: Implemented StandardScaler plus ridge alpha=1, fit on other mice; each training mouse total weight one.

comparators.name: Tuning-plus-nuisance held-mouse ridge
comparators.inputs: Same nuisance features plus tuning similarity and site-class interaction
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed alpha=1 paired reference on identical train/test mice; gain does not establish causal tuning influence.

comparators.name: Full-schedule response estimator and null diagnostics
comparators.inputs: Complete overlapping target×power×condition schedule, calcium, artifact/support masks and movement
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed ridge alpha=1, ten100ms lag bins through1s, exposure-integrated design; lead schedule and within-distance tuning rotations are diagnostics, not randomization p-values.
